stem.text: Which diagram represents the electric field line pattern due to a combination of two positive charges?

A.alt: Electric field line pattern with two charges marked +, drawn as closed loops around both charges.

B.alt: Electric field line pattern with two charges marked +, with field lines curving between them and lines leaving each charge outwards.

C.alt: Electric field line pattern showing parallel horizontal lines with arrows pointing left, and two charges marked +.

D.alt: Electric field line pattern with two charges marked +, each with lines leaving it in all directions.
